== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Phoenix]] Division is a branch of the [[Abidan]] tasked with the critical roles of healing and reconstruction. Operating out of a massive headquarters in [[Sanctum]] characterized by mountain-sized white domes, the division functions as the most significant medical facility in existence. Beyond providing medical care, Phoenixes are responsible for repairing damage across the sectors they control, which includes mending fractured worlds caused by spatial attacks, fighting off corruption, and restoring entire continents. While they can return things to their previous state of order to prolong a world's life, their restorative abilities only delay inevitable decay. Due to the widespread damage across all ten sectors under [[Abidan]] control, the division is currently facing extreme pressure and is considered perhaps the most overworked of all the [[Abidan]] divisions.}}
